Interior Design & Decoration

Interior Architecture · 3D Visualization
01 / Graduation Project

Synapse Library — Abis

A public library for Abis, Alexandria, developed through a parametric biophilic design approach inspired by neural cells and synaptic connections. The project brings together site analysis, zoning, concept development, plans, sections, interior visualization and material studies.
ParametricBiophilicPublic LibraryInterior Architecture
02 / Client Project

Retail Interior — Vape & Tobacco Store

A commissioned retail interior project developed outside the university context. The design explores a strong geometric language through custom shelving, layered wall treatments, hexagonal display details, dark wood, marble-look surfaces and integrated lighting.
Client WorkRetail Interior3D VisualizationCustom Display
03 / Academic Project

Medical Resort

Interior design project exploring a therapeutic resort environment through spatial planning, interior perspectives, material studies and architectural sections.
Interior DesignPlanningSectionsMaterial Study
04 / Academic Project

Corona — Commercial Interior

A commercial interior study combining a detailed plan, zoning, mood and material references, perspectives and longitudinal sections.

Graphic Design & Print

Selected print and packaging work developed for clients, including menu design, food packaging and branded print materials. The work covers visual layout, typography, brand application and production-ready artwork.

LAMADA — Packaging Collection

Packaging artwork developed for LAMADA, including fries and tortilla packaging. The project covers dieline-based artwork, typography, illustration, brand application and print-ready visual composition.

A vehicle branding application for LAMADA, showing the artwork layout and its real-world food truck application. The project combines brand graphics, Arabic and English typography, imagery and promotional messaging into a large-format exterior composition.

I'm Kirollos Wadie Labib, an Interior Designer & Graphic Designer based in Alexandria, Egypt. I recently completed my Bachelor's Degree in Fine Arts — Decor Department at Alexandria University (2021–2026).

My work combines interior design, 3D modeling, technical drafting, branding, packaging design and print production. I have worked on freelance and project-based assignments since 2022, translating client ideas into spatial and visual solutions.

01 / Freelance · Project-Based

Interior & Graphic Designer

Developed 3D models and interior spatial layouts using 3ds Max and AutoCAD. In parallel, delivered graphic design for multiple clients, including menus, packaging, brand identities, promotional collateral and business print materials. Prepared production-ready artwork, pre-press files and packaging die-lines, and created 2D CNC/routing paths with ArtCAM for custom decorative elements and woodwork.

02 / Design & Print Projects

Graphic & Print Design Specialist

Executed artwork preparation for offset and digital printing, with a focus on precise color profiles, packaging die-lines and production accuracy. Worked with clients to translate their requirements into menus, packaging, business stationery and marketing materials.
